role: The /summon command: builds an entity from its entity id plus optional coordinates and NBT (with Riding chains), runs onSpawnWithEgg for living entities and spawns it.
scope_reason: Never reached: the agent and RL paths have no chat or command input (SPEC input: look, gui ops, held keys; no command source), and the native engine has no command dispatcher. world.conf does not list commands.

members.name: processCommand
members.note: not the command: agent mode has no chat. The harness dev op (csrc/engine/dev.c, folded through serverreplay_summon_hostile) covers the same entity-creation half, and the vanilla hook in this command is netherite.oracle.WorldConf.checkSummon (oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/WorldConf.java:122), which both sides call so switched-off entities cannot be summoned.

notes: The only command in this batch with a vanilla hook: processCommand calls netherite.oracle.WorldConf.checkSummon (one of the 14 hand hook edits).
